rationale: Both axis labels carry units in parentheses, the y label sits horizontally above the axis (the modern convention) and neither has data-role. AXIS_WORDS wraps '(.*)' and '%' in \b, which never matches after a space or at the end of a string, so the critic reports 'axis label(s) with units are missing'. Rule change: detect a parenthesised unit or a trailing % without word boundaries, and accept an unrotated text whose bbox sits just above the y axis.
